prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Kingdra (킹드라) personified, water / dragon type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes fixed on one point, mouth firmly closed
Pose: Work at a kitchen counter, stirring a bowl or arranging ingredients with clearly separated hands and utensils.
Orientation: torso leaning forward with supported balance
Scene: At a raised kitchen tea counter on a rainy morning, pouring steaming berry tea from a clear glass pot into a small cup; both utensils are held at sternum height, above the raised counter.
Outfit and props: A deep-V white cotton blouse with rolled short sleeves, a cropped knotted hem, worn separately over a cobalt knee-length high-waist skirt; blue spiral cuff embroidery and one tiny silver barrette.
Category: Show a specific everyday cooking, berry-growing or picnic activity in the Pokémon world. Use readable hands, utensils and ingredients; favor ordinary personal life over professional workwear.
Example scene: Pouring warm berry tea into a cup at a small kitchen table with a teapot and sliced fruit.
Framing: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
Lens / perspective: 135mm-equivalent telephoto perspective from farther away, with compressed background depth and unchanged anatomy.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: strong — clearly recognizable source palette and motifs in clothing, not new armor or creature anatomy
separates_preference: strongly prefer separates — use separate top and bottom by default; explicit outfit takes priority

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers of natural length, clearly separated, never merged, doubled or extra.
